text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик, Грасс Вандер, T.M.
Opera
O—surrounded by all these
powerful opponents,
Мэйсё Дото loses
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her lack of courage is offset
by an
abundance of determination. She
takes to the
turf, backed by a long
history of persistent effort!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
